about: The README gallery: each shot is the demo in one look, pasted onto the screen of one kitchen scene. art/make_gallery.py reads this. Scenes and their screen corners live in art/kitchen/. A light theme goes on a scene with a dark frame (counter-a): on the white wall-mount it did not read as a screen. glow brightens the dark themes; a shot can set its own (light washes out, so 1.0).

seasons.about: docs/seasons.jpg, the README's seasonal-looks picture: a 2x2 sheet of the wall in its best looks. The owner: 'Our seasonal one should really showcase the best, which is Christmas and Halloween.'
